Strategic Insights & Recommendations

Segment 0: High-Value Customers (40.3%)

  • Spending Power: Outspends regular customers by 6.8x ($1,234 vs $182).
  • Key Categories: Premium Wines ($608 avg) and Meat Products ($359 avg).
  • Channel Behavior: Heavy in-store (8.6 purchases) and catalog shoppers (5.3 purchases).
  • Action: Launch VIP concierge perks, early wine reserve releases, and personalized direct mail catalog promotions.

Segment 1: Regular Customers (59.7%)

  • Engagement Gap: Visit the website 6.4 times/month (vs 3.8 for high-value), but have low conversion rates.
  • Price Sensitivity: Average income is $39,337 with average basket spending of $182.
  • Action: Use digital cart incentives, entry-level discount bundles, and flash deals to convert frequent web visits into completed checkouts.

K-Means Cluster Selection (Silhouette Score)

Evaluated k=2 through k=8. k=2 achieves the peak silhouette score (0.312), indicating optimal cluster separation and cohesion.

Customer Segmentation – 2D PCA View

PCA reduces multidimensional spending, recency, and demographic features into 2 primary components (explaining 52.2% of total variance). Clear separation between High-Value (Cluster 0) and Regular (Cluster 1).
